text: SYNTHETIC INCOMING RECORD. Case NXS-007. Cyber Crime Police Station, Navapur. Complainant reports fraudulent investment debit of Rs 450,000 following extortion calls from suspect calling via phone SYN-PHONE-001 claiming affiliation with Veyra Services. Extortion funds routed to intermediary account SYN-ACCOUNT-007. Accused Karan Bhati; location Navapur Sector 7; associated vehicle DL01AB9999.
